name: any2u1
description: A browser extension that turns a 3MF from Bambu Studio, Creality Print, Anycubic Slicer Next, ElegooSlicer, Flash Studio, PrusaSlicer or QIDI Studio into a Snapmaker U1 file, entirely on your device.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.test:firefox: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.firefox.config.ts
